title: Concept: MD5 selected by name (apex) — review required
description: In apex, naming MD5 (generateDigests*(s*'MD5') requests a broken digest. Name-selected digests hide inside factory calls, so reviewers must check the string, not just the call. The apex-specific remedy is selecting 'SHA-256'.
applicability: apex codebases selecting digests by name; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Same as any MD5 use: forged digests where security is assumed; LOW default severity, raised when the digest guards trust.
